user.title: Connect to Emailable
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to an Emailable server. This can be your primary VPS, Docker, Coolify, or local add-on instance. Create an API key in Emailable under Settings > Endpoints and paste it here.

data_description.base_url: The root URL of the Emailable app, for example https://emailable.example.com or http://homeassistant.local:3000.
data_description.api_key: A bearer API key created from the Emailable app. This lets Home Assistant call actions without duplicating Emailable setup.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Emailable with that URL and API key. Check that the URL is reachable from Home Assistant and that the key was copied correctly.
